faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.sub: Answers to common questions about IVContent
faq.a1: IVContent is a content repurposing tool that helps you transform one piece of content into multiple formats for different platforms — saving you time, boosting reach, and helping you stay consistent.
faq.q2: How do I start using it?
faq.a2: Simply sign up for an account, choose a tool from the dashboard, paste your content, and click “Repurpose.”
faq.q3: What does the Lifetime Deal include?
faq.a3: The LTD gives you unlimited access to all current tools and future features, forever — with no monthly fees.
faq.a4: Yes! If you start with a monthly plan, you can upgrade to yearly or lifetime at any time from your account settings.
faq.a5: Absolutely. We never sell your data and only store what's necessary to run the service securely.

qs.title: Quick Start Guide
qs.sub: Learn how to use IVContent in minutes
qs.step1: Sign Up or Log In – Create your IVContent account or log in to your existing one.
qs.step2: Enter Your Content – Paste your blog, video script, or text into the input box.
qs.step3: Select a Format – Choose what you want to create (e.g., Blog Summary, TikTok Script, Pinterest Caption).
qs.step4: Click 'Repurpose' – Let IVContent work its magic and instantly transform your content.
qs.step5: Review & Edit – Make any tweaks to your generated content in the output box.
qs.step6: Download or Copy – Save your new content as a file or copy it to your clipboard for immediate use.
